nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer SPF 50

avis.texte: I used this sunscreen for about 2 years and I loved it!! It made my skin dewy and my skin always felt hydrated after application. BUT. It seems they may have changed the formula when they changed the bottle! I even said to my boyfriend, "Oh they changed the bottle, I wonder why they calling it a "new" product if its the same thing just a different bottle?" My skin has broken out like never before! Even as a kid during puberty, ive NEVER had acne like this. Ive also never had many skin issues before, i would consider my skin to be very 'normal'. I switched out different cleansing products, changed my habits, and even changed my diet. Goes to show how much i trusted this product. (or trusted the previous one i should say). THIS PRODUCT WILL BREAK YOU OUT. Be wary :(
This made my eyes burn, sting, and water immediately after applying. I did not apply it on my eye area.

This makes eyes burn and sting like crazy. I didn't even apply it anywhere near my eyes, yet the irritation was so bad that I couldn't open them for about an hour. My eyes were watering and burning and I had to flush them out repeatedly. Even after removing the product, my eyes were irritated for the entire day. I love the regular hydro boost cream, but this I will not be using again.

avis.titre: Not as good as previous version
avis.texte: Bought this a few weeks ago—ive USED FOR YEARS—DO NOT LIKE THIS NEW VERSION—IT Goes ON DRY, FEELS PASTE LIKE. IM LOOKING for ANOTHER BRAND TO REPLACE THIS. REALLY DISAPPOINTED

avis.titre: One of the best tools to stay looking younger long
avis.texte: Hyaluronic acid is essential to all skin care routines no matter your age. It absorbs into the skin and can take years off when used consistently over time. Goes on smooth and dries with no sticky residue. Protects against those pesky fine li es and wrinkles.

I bought this because of the reviews hoping for something that would wear well under makeup for daily use. Its more lotion texture than I expected for something thats supposed to be a gel cream and it pills extremely bad even on clean dry skin but even worse on top of any other serums. Cant use due to this issue and pretty spendy for the size, I do not recommend

Every time i use this my eyes start burning 4-8 hours after application even though i avoid putting it near my eyes. It also makes my face feel grimy. I love their water boost cream but this is the worst product ive ever used on my face. Will not buy again.

avis.titre: A fast-absorbing, hydrating moisturizer with salic
avis.texte: has a lightweight, gel-cream texture that absorbs quickly and helps smooth skin while providing hydration. The salicylic acid aids gentle exfoliation and helps keep pores clear, making it suitable for normal to oily or acne-prone skin. It smells good and gives you that shiny finishing

The product delivers great performance while maintaining a lightweight, comfortable feeling on the skin. It helps minimize breakouts and improves overall appearance. The level of comfort it provides makes it easy to use every day.

I love two in one products because I like my routine simple. I love this has spf of 50. It does help moisturize my face thanks to the hyaluronic acid. However, it makes my face a little too shiny so for me this is good for when I don't wear makeup.
Unfortunately, this product caused my eyes to burn, even on an indoor winter's day when I did not sweat At all.
This is great my 40+ sensitive dry skin with rosacea! Glowy withiut being greasy-stays soft and moisturized all day and no pilling under make-up. Plays well with mg actives too!

avis.titre: Great option if you're looking for hydration, sun
avis.texte: I really like the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer SPF 50. It feels very lightweight on the skin, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a greasy or heavy feeling. My skin feels hydrated, fresh, and smooth after applying it.

Very nice and light moisturizing sunscreen. So easy to use and great to have for the summer or even all year round. It works and does not burn your eyes. I have not had a breakout from this so I approve.

avis.titre: A lightweight, hydrating moisturizer with SPF 50 t
avis.texte: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer SPF 50 feels lightweight and refreshing on the skin while providing great hydration. The texture absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy, making it perfect for daily use. It layers well under makeup and offers strong sun protection without leaving a white cast. My skin feels smooth, hydrated, and protected throughout the day.
This is my go-to daily spf moisturizer. I love that it's not too thick so my makeup sits well on it. It also smells good. Some spf moisturizers have a heavy sunscreen scent, but this one doesn't.
My favorite of their hydroboost line!! Not greasy goes on smoothly and fragrance free. Just wish they sold a bigger bottle. My sensitive skin loves it,
My favorite of their hydroboost line!! Not greasy goes on smoothly and fragrance free. Just wish they sold a bigger bottle. My sensitive skin loves it, I use it after my day time face routine.

I recently purchased this sunscreen moisturizer to replace my Supergoop Triple Prep. I have very sensitive eyes when it comes to sunscreen—most formulas make my eyes burn or water so much that I have to wash everything off. Needless to say, I'm extremely cautious about trying new sunscreens. I applied this one as I normally would, and while the first hour was fine, after that my eyes started burning intensely. I ended up immediately reordering my beloved Supergoop sunscreen and won't be using this one again.

If you are looking for a skin-friendly cream that still "feels good", Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer SPF 50 is a "base brick" for your daily skincare cycle! With an ultra-light gel-cream texture, absorbs quickly and does not leave a greasy feeling — ready for you to apply and then go to work, or under makeup. The main ingredient is hyaluronic acid that helps "absuck water" into the skin, plus SPF 50 protects the skin from UV rays.

I loved this moisturizer! I've been looking for a good SPF that doesn't feel oily. This was super light and didn't leave me feeling greasy throughout the day. It doesn't have a smell that I've noticed either. Would recommend!!!
I'm 47 used this for years- . It's great. It's thin consistency, not heavy. Makeup/ primer go well over it. I wish it just came in bigger ounces available.

avis.titre: My first choice in the AM!
avis.texte: This moisturizer is my go-to morning product! If I'm only going to use one thing in the morning, this is the one that I'm grabbing. I love the lightweight texture, the moisture it adds to my skin, and that it's 50 SPF! It's a great way to refresh my skin before the day and applies smoothly under makeup.

First, I LOVE this product, Love the fluid consistancy and SPF 50, however, I will NOT buy it again! The last three pumps have not worked! ! the last one, I had to pry off the top to use the product. Im switching to ROC, or some other daily moisturizer with a functioning delivery of its product. I would have rated it 5 star if the freakin' pump worked!
I found this sunscreen to be irritating to my eyes while wearing and especially so when washing off. It has a pleasant scent and the spf 50 is great.

This is a great moisturizer that leaves skin moisturized, but not greasy. It made my skin smooth and most importantly was an easy application prior to heading outside in the sun. I enjoyed this product and will buy again.
I'm mid 40s. Definitely need sunscreen when using retinol@ night.. this is nice and thin, and blends well with my loreal foundation. Definitely recommend. Wish it was bigger size! . 4 stars.

Neutrogena is my go to product. I don't know how I really feel about this one. I don't see big difference. The texture is OK. The packaging is normal and I believe the sun protection is fine. The scent is light. It does the job, but definitely not my favorite.

avis.titre: protects skin without feeling heavy or greasy
avis.texte: I really enjoy using the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer SPF 50 because it combines hydration and sun protection in one step. The texture is lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly into my skin without leaving a heavy white cast, which is a big plus for daily wear. It layers well under makeup and keeps my skin feeling soft and plump throughout the day thanks to the hyaluronic acid. The pump packaging is convenient and hygienic, and the product has a fresh, clean scent that isn't overpowering. I appreciate that it provides broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection while still feeling like a moisturizer rather than a sunscreen. My only small note is that if you have very oily skin, you may prefer to set it with powder to avoid shine later in the day, but overall, it's an excellent multitasking product.

A really nice moisturizer for the winter months! It was a little thicker than the og watergel but I really like how it included SPF. I will say the Spf scent was quite heavy, and the pump could be difficult at times.
LOve this as i need spf 50 just make it bigger Make s night one too

I have went through sooo many bottles of this. I have combination skin and this gives me the most beautiful glow a moisturizer has ever given plus it has spf!! No white coat just glides on so smooth. Neutral scent and the perfect pump dispenser. The only thing I'd change is offering a bigger size bottle!

avis.titre: Definitely worth it.  You won't be disappointed
avis.texte: Love love love. This is great for in the morning before my makeup. The smoothness is amazing and doesn't feel sticky. It's a sunscreen too so I know it's protecting my skin. It doesn't have a fragrance which is a plus cause it's going on my face which my face doesn't do well with scented creams

I've been using the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid and SPF 50 for a few days now, and I'm already impressed! The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any greasy or heavy residue. I especially love how it hydrates my skin instantly while also offering strong sun protection — a huge bonus for my daily skincare routine. The pump packaging is super convenient and mess-free. One pump is enough to cover my face evenly. It doesn't leave a white cast, and it layers well under makeup too. I noticed my skin feels soft and fresh throughout the day without any dryness or irritation. Perfect for anyone looking for a daily moisturizer that hydrates and protects with SPF 50. Definitely a new staple in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: It is ok but too shiny for me
avis.texte: This product is ok for a sunscreen. It feels ok when you first put it on but gets flaky towards the end of application. It is very moisturizing but extremely to shiny and greasy for me . If it wasn't for that I would repurchase it .
best product for my acne-prone skin. makes my skin glowy and i think it's been healing my moisture barrier

avis.titre: only sunscreen to break me out in a long time
avis.texte: broke me out so badly I am still dealing with it a month later will never use again

I've been using this product about a month now and I do really like it. The only issue I have is it does leave a little bit of a white cast to the face. It has great ingredients and I love that it has spf for those no makeup days.

avis.titre: Beautiful Hydrating Sunscreen for Under Makeup
avis.texte: Chemical sunscreens can be an irritant to those with sensitive or acne-prone skin, but even as someone who's skin is incredibly dry, I cannot speak highly enough about this SPF Moisturizer. Not only does it play well with pretty much every coverage product I regularly use, it doesn't cause breakouts or irritate my skin. I love wearing this to hydrate my skin before makeup application because it sinks in so beautifully without any pilling or greasy feeling. My skin feels hydrated, soft and smooth -- the perfect canvas for makeup! However, it does burn my eyes if I apply it too close to them, so that's a bit of a bummer, but I have yet to find a chemical sunscreen that doesn't burn my eyes. Overall, I absolutely love this product and will continue to use and repurchase for the foreseeable future!!!

PAckaging issue, pump does not work. Very cheap pump, couldn't get the product out the way it was intended. Had to break into it and scrape it into my Garnier pump tube that works. Product seems fine, but please fix packaging

I'm a super fan of neutrogena products. I love their gel cleanser and the gel cream moisturizer. However, this one I didn't really like. I noticed that the sunscreen left my face feeling a little heavy and that the product did pill after applying. It doesn't work well under my makeup either.

avis.titre: Who knew a sunscreen could be so light
avis.texte: This hydroboost hyatheronic acid moisturizer was spf 50 is my new go to for my daily skincare routine. It is unscented and extremely lightweight. Normal spf feels heavy and greasy, and this does not. I use my serums and then this for my no makeup days and I love it.
My friend had the higher end ultra sheer Neutrogena sunscreen, and she had to use mine instead; this doesn't make you look like a ghost, and with a spf of 50 it was great for the Grand Canyon
I bough it thinki that it w be more like gel and that won't be greasy or oily, but the texture is not what i expected and my face feels Really heavy and oily

This product is created with a simple packaging design that speaks for itself. Packed with spf the scent reminds me of summer at the beach. It goes on light and barely feels like you are wearing any sun protection !
love love this SPF moisturizer! my skin loves this product. I have acne prone - combination skin and this hyaluronic acid moisturizer is the best for it.

avis.texte: Very lightweight, gel-based moisturizer that hydrates while providing sun protection. Infused with hyaluronic acid, it delivers long-lasting moisture, making skin feel plump and refreshed. The broad-spectrum SPF 30 helps protect against UV damage without feeling heavy or greasy. It absorbs quickly and works well under makeup. Fragrance free, and cute bottle!

avis.titre: Perfect product give it a try
avis.texte: This Neutrogena sunscreen and moisturizer worked really well for me. The packaging was nice and I appreciate it being fragrance and dye free. The ingredients are also very clean as well.

This moisturizer contains hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid, which means the molecules have been broken down into smaller pieces to enhance the absorption into the skin. Scientifically, it should do a decent job hydrating, and therefore smoothing out the skin and minimizing the appearance of wrinkles. In actually I did notice my face was more hydrated. I love that it comes with SPF 50 so I can use it as my daily moisturizer. It gives my face a dewy glow without making it appear greasy, even by the end of the day. I didn't even need to use powder to balance out the sunscreen. Would recommend.

I have been using this sun product for several days and this is my impression of it. Its texture is really light, it absorbs quickly into my skin and doesn't leave a white cast on my face. It's effect is matte, it doesn't leave my face shiny or greasy which I loved because my skin tends to be combination to oily. It contains hyaluronic acid and vitamin E so it not only protects my skin but also moisturises it. I love that it has SPF 50 because I can use it every day and my skin is really protected during the day. It says on the packaging that the formula is non-comedogenic so it shouldn't cause any acne breakouts and it doesn't contain any fragrance. I think it's one of my favourite Neutrogena sunscreens and I will buy it again. My face feels hydrated, smooth and glowing when I apply it and it has a sunscreen factor of 50 so it's the best of both worlds, a moisturiser and a sunscreen in one product

It's perfect for daily use, providing my skin with much-needed hydration while also offering strong sun protection. I love how it keeps my skin feeling soft and smooth throughout the day. This is a great LIGHT moisturizer. I have fairly dry skin so I tried this as a replacement moisturizer, but felt my skin was still a bit dry during the day. So I ended up adding this as an extra because of the SPF and ended up being a great move for myself. It's very lightweight and absorbs into my skin quick.

I recieved this product as a free sample from hometesterclub. It made my skin feel so clean and moisturized. I would 10 out of 10 recommend.

At first I really liked the packaging, I thought the amount of product contained was excellent. When I tested it I liked the creaminess and the smell, when I spread it on my face I felt that it was very pleasant and long-lasting because with a small amount I spread it well on my face, right after applying it I felt good, my skin was soft and it wasn't sticky or smelling like sunscreen. I loved it!
This works well for me, but I really don't need or want the spf, I'd rather it just moisturize! But for what the product is supposed to do, it works great!
Product is not bad a moisturizer but had a very strong sunscreen smell that lasted for hours. The product itself is lightweight when you put it on and leaves your face feeling smooth.
I thought that this product was pretty good. I like that it didn't feel heavy or greasy. It absorbed into the skin nicely. I didn't notice any type of white cast, which was great.

avis.titre: Quality packaging and leaves skin soft
avis.texte: I really love this moisturizer, the packaging is a really sturdy plastic and it feels so expensive. The moisturizer itself is hydrating but not sticky, just soft! I do wish it came with a mini applicator so it's less messy. Otherwise it's an amazing product.

Neutrogena Hydro Boost Moisturizer with Sunscreen SPF 50 is a standout product that combines deep hydration with reliable sun protection. Infused with hyaluronic acid, it keeps the skin feeling plump, smooth, and moisturized throughout the day. The lightweight, non-greasy formula absorbs quickly and works seamlessly under makeup, making it a versatile addition to any skincare routine. The broad-spectrum SPF 50 offers excellent defense against harmful UVA and UVB rays, a crucial feature for maintaining healthy skin. I also appreciate that it doesn't leave a white cast, a common issue with many high-SPF products. Perfect for normal to dry skin types, this moisturizer is a game-changer for anyone seeking a two-in-one product that saves time and delivers results. My only minor critique is the fragrance, which may not suit those with sensitive skin. Overall, it's a highly eff

This is my favorite new sunscreen/moisturizer. When you first put it on there's a bit of a white cast, but once you massage it into the skin, there's no cast left. It does not feel oily or greasy. Honestly, it leaves my skin feeling really well hydrated, and covered, but not heavy. I will definitely be using this on a daily basis.

This daily moisturizer applies evenly and clear. It didnt make my face oily or breakout. I like the easy application and size of product. I wish it was reef friendly though. I would recommend this product.

I actually really enjoyed using the Neutrogena Hydroboost SPF over the last few weeks. I used this on top of another cream moisturizer as I am really dry in the weather and I absolutely loved the finish on this. This didn't leave me greasy as some other sunscreens can do. In addition, this moisturizer didn't leave a whitecast on my brown skin, which is always positive. However, this was only 1.7oz, so it will run out quickly with daily use.

As a person with dry and sensitive skin I rate this product 4/5 stars. I love how moisturizing it is and how easy it is to apply. I find that it sinks it quite quickly and lays well under makeup. However due to my sensitive skin, I found that this product causes a very slight tingly/burning sensation that lasts about 5 minutes after application. I do love everything else about it but I do wish it was more sensitive skin friendly. I will continue to use it but I would be cautious if you have sensitive skin.
The hydro boost moisturizer is lightweight and left my face feeling moisturized and nourished. What I like about this moisturizer is that it's not thick and doesn't break me out.
I like that it doesn't leave any oily residue on my skin. It's very hydrating and I like it, especially in winters. I also like that it didn't leave any white cast on my tan skin.

This Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Facial Moisturizer with Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Sunscreen moisturizer keeps my skin feeling soft and hydrated all day. I love that it also provides SPF 50 protection from the sun without being greasy. Perfect for daily use to keep your face moisturized.
I love how this moisturizer with spf is non-greasy and fragrance free(especially since a lot of spf products have a strong scent). This product is weightless and blends into the skin very easily.

I was very impressed by this product. At first I thought I had a faulty pump, but after a few more tries it started working. It goes on smooth and turns invisible shortly after. It's moisturizing without feeling heavy or oily. It's been able to help me keep my skin hydrated and soft!

I really enjoyed the product worked really well. I didn't really seen a difference, my face glowed. After a week.

I was in the market for a new everyday SPF and am super happy I came across this product! This HydroBoost formula provides not only great moisture but also high SPF, which I love. The pump bottle makes it super easy to use, I am able to cover my whole face and even a bit down to my neck with one pump every morning. It dries pretty quickly and only leaves me a little greasy by the end of the day. Excited to keep using this as my everyday product!
I love how light the moisturizer is. It is on the oily side but it works well since I tend to have drier skin and put makeup over it so I'm not a greaseball throughout the day.

I enjoyed using this product. It applies smoothly and keeps my skin hydrated through the day without reapplying. It also doesn't have the distinct sunscreen scent, which is a plus. A small amount goes a long way and it has a good consistency. It doesn't clog my pores or make my skin look greasy, which is an issue I typically have with other moisturizers that contain sunscreen.

I really like this moisturizer. It makes my skin so soft and hydrated while also giving me sun protection. This product would be perfect for anyone who is out in the sun a lot or just an every day moisturizer.

avis.titre: Smooth, hydrating, and protects from UVs
avis.texte: This moisturizer dispenses in a thin stream and one pump goes a long way. It has an initial scent of sunscreen, which is probably because it has sunscreen! It goes on and dries very quickly. My face didn't feel sticky or look oily, which I appreciated. I also could not smell it once it was on my skin. The packaging has a lid on it so that you don't accidentally dispense anything. After applying my skin felt smooth and it was nice to know that I was protected from the sun while keeping my face hydrated. I have tried Neutrogena moisturizer before, but the added SPF protection is a nice bonus. The bottle is also very travel friendly.

I think Neutrogena Hydro Boost Moisturizer with SPF 50 is a really good product.I like how light weight it feels on my skin.My skin feels more hydrated now and i have dry skin so i am happy that i found a product that is actually helping with that.It has made my skin feel alot more smoother. Neutrogena is definitely a brand that i trust because they make good quality products!I also like the size of the bottle it's portable so i can carry it in my bag if i want too.

This is a great sunscreen! It's an spf 50 which is a great amount of protection. My skin feels so smooth and very hydrated. I'll sometimes either wear it alone or I'll wear it underneath makeup. I love that it does not leave a white cast like most sunscreens tend to do. It's hypoallergenic and non-comedogenic which is great for people with sensitive skin. I would definitely recommend buying this if you are looking for something hydrating especially with no white cast.

I like the convenience of this product. I've I used it on days were I spend a lot of time outside, and it has never left my face feeling greasy. I likely would buy this product again, if there is an option for one with fragrance.
Makes my skin feel moisturized but not greasy. Love the extra protection from the sun. This would be a good makeup base.

The Neutrogena Hydro Boost Moisturizer with SPF 50 is a pretty good product. The product was not greasy feeling and it blended well into my dark skin tone I have. I provided great hydration for my dry skin as well. It was very lightweight and did not feel heavy or like the product was even on my face after rubbing it into my skin. I also loved that this product is fragrance-free.

I have very oily skin at times and have tried all kinds of things but this is a great product. Aside from the spf which is great it feels light and clean and comes off super easy. I would recommend to anyone

I'm grateful to have been sent this Neutrogena Hydroboost Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer with Sunscreen for free in exchange for my review. I love the ingredients in this and that it has the added sunscreen because it seems like it should be pretty good for anti-aging. It's a really good moisturizer for dry skin and I would definitely repurchase it.

This moisturizer stands out with its SPF 50, offering excellent sun protection. While I expected a more water-based, lightweight feel, the added sunscreen does create a slightly tacky texture as it dries. It's still a good option for daily use if you're looking for a two-in-one moisturizer and sunscreen, but the finish may not be ideal for those who prefer a completely weightless feel.

avis.titre: Hydration and Sun Protection in One!
avis.texte: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Moisturizer with Sunscreen SPF 50 is a game-changer! It provides intense hydration without feeling greasy, and the high SPF offers excellent sun protection. The lightweight, non-comedogenic formula absorbs quickly, leaving skin smooth and refreshed. Perfect for everyday use—highly recommend!
I love how it hydrates my face and so lightweight and leave with no white cast.

I thought this was very hydrating but it felt decently thick on my face. I usually go for something a little lighter on my face so that is my only note that I wish it wasn't as heavy on my face. I would recommend those with drier skin than mine to try out this product because i do have combo to oily skin.

It is the ultimate multitasker! It combines intense hydration with high sun protection in a way that feels effortless. The lightweight, water-gel texture is a dream—it glides on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed without any sticky or greasy residue. The SPF 50 provides strong protection against harmful UV rays, and what sets it apart is that it doesn't leave a white cast, even on my medium-toned skin. It works beautifully under makeup, making it perfect for daily use. What I truly appreciate is how gentle it is. My skin tends to be a bit sensitive, but this moisturizer feels soothing and never causes irritation. It's also non-comedogenic, so I don't have to worry about breakouts. If you're looking for a product that hydrates, protects, and feels amazing on the skin.

This product is great! It makes my face feel more hydrated than it ever did before. Not to mention it's helping from sun marks/burns as it has sunscreen in it as well. The packaging says fragrance free which it is but you can definitely smell the sunscreen. Not a big deal though it's not a bad smell or anything. All in all, I'd definitely recommend to friends/family

With spf, moisturizer, and foundation and end up a hot greasy mess. I love this product so much! It doesn't break out my skin, I don't get insanely greasy. Although there is a light shine, it makes my skin look healthy and calm. The first day I wore this, and only this, I got tons of compliments on the healthy condition of my skin.
